title: Gold Bar XL Cherry Fizz Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Gold Bar XL Refill Kit in Cherry Fizz pairs the bold sweetness of Red Cherry with a sparkling soda-style edge. It comes with a 2ml prefilled pod and an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, both preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid. This refill combo keeps the flavour going for longer while delivering a smooth, discreet MTL draw. Made to fit the Gold Bar XL Prefilled Pod Kit, this all-in-one refill pack is easy to install and preloaded for fuss-free use. The built-in mesh coil ensures enhanced flavour delivery with consistent vapour output throughout It's lifespan.
